player_prompt.intro:
Aweyi kɔnɔ {player_id} le kɛɛlɛ kɛɛlɛ {num_rounds} tɩŋa Rock-Paper-Scissors tɔm.
Aweyi ɖɛɛma taa wɛʋ kɛɛlɛ pɩŋa yɔɔ.
Kɛɛlɛ kɛɛlɛ taa, ɖɩɩɩ wɛʋ '[rock]', '[paper]', ɛntɛ '[scissors]'.
Aweyi ɖɛɛma taa wɛʋ '[r]', '[p]', ɛntɛ '[s]' ɛzɩ kɔɔlɩɩ.

outcome.p1_wins: Ɛyʋ kajalaɣ ñɩnʋ wabɩ paa weyi lɛ.
